title: Line of Duty: Evaluating LLM Self-Knowledge via Consistency in Feasibility Boundaries
reasoning: The paper includes 'Ethical Integrity' as one of the five core categories of self-knowledge that it evaluates and benchmarks. It specifically measures how well LLMs recognize feasibility boundaries related to malicious intent and offensive topics, providing specific metrics (Accuracy, Foresight, and Insight) for this ethical category across multiple models.
